verdict.rationale: Meta positions Llama weights/docs as 'open' and provides model cards, weights, and code repos, but the actual license is the Llama Community License with use-policy restrictions (e.g., 700M MAU carve-out) rather than an OSI-approved open license, and community commenters explicitly contest the 'open source' framing ('Another non-open source license... don't let anyone tell you this is open source'; 'Llama is not open source. It's corporate freeware'). The source/weights also require accepting gated terms on Hugging Face rather than being freely readable. Missing for 10: an actual OSI-approved open license, evidence of unrestricted source/weight access, and resolution of the community dispute over 'open' claims.
